mapper.select: SELECT id FROM t_authorized_contact_vault WHERE contact_type = 'ATTACHMENT_GRANT' AND fingerprint = #{fingerprint} AND attachment_id = #{attachmentId} AND source_id = #{sourceId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND ( (#{purpose} = 'INLINE_VIEW' AND access_reason NOT LIKE 'ORIGINAL_LOG_DOWNLOAD|%' AND access_reason NOT LIKE 'DERIVED_PREVIEW|%') OR (#{purpose} = 'DERIVED_PREVIEW' AND access_reason LIKE 'DERIVED_PREVIEW|%') OR (#{purpose} = 'ORIGINAL_LOG_DOWNLOAD' AND access_reason LIKE 'ORIGINAL_LOG_DOWNLOAD|%') ) AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE t_authorized_contact_vault SET consumed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3) WHERE id = #{grantId} AND contact_type = 'ATTACHMENT_GRANT' AND consumed_at IS NULL AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)
